name: client-status
title: Client status report: DRAFT
for_each: select id,name from matters order by name

sections.title: Matter
sections.sql: select b.name,b.client,b.visa_type,b.adviser,b.next_due from matter_board b where id=$1

sections.title: Applications
sections.sql: select name,status,reference,lodged_on,outcome from applications where matter_id=$1

sections.title: Dates recorded from source notices
sections.sql: select name,kind,due_on,source_ref from deadlines where matter_id=$1 and done_on is null
sections.note: Adviser checks source dates before giving advice. Nothing is lodged or sent.

name: evidence-request
title: Evidence request: DRAFT
for_each: select id,name from matters order by name

sections.title: Client and matter
sections.sql: select name,client,visa_type from matter_board where id=$1

sections.title: Required evidence
sections.sql: select name,due_on,received_on,verified_on from evidence where matter_id=$1 and required and verified_on is null
sections.note: Items received but unverified need adviser review, not another request to the client.

name: file-index
title: Client file index
for_each: select id,name from matters order by name

sections.title: Application copies
sections.sql: select name,reference,copy_ref from applications where matter_id=$1

sections.title: Communications
sections.sql: select happened_on,kind,author,body,confirmed_ref from notes where matter_id=$1 order by happened_on

sections.title: Invoices and receipts
sections.note: References point to files in your secure archive. This index does not contain the document files.

name: fee-statement
title: Practice fee statement: DRAFT
for_each: select id,name from matters order by name

sections.title: Client and matter
sections.sql: select name,client from matter_board where id=$1

sections.title: Recorded invoices
sections.sql: select name,currency,amount,paid,amount-paid balance,due_on,invoice_ref,receipt_ref from fees where matter_id=$1
sections.note: Administrative fee records only. No trust ledger, payment handling or tax invoice certification.
